## About
APR Automotive Repair is a full service shop on N McQueen Rd in Gilbert, serving Mesa, Gilbert, Chandler and the surrounding areas. We started APR to give people quality auto repair and a shop they can trust.
Too many folks leave a repair shop feeling like they were lied to or treated unfairly. We want you to leave knowing the work was done right and that nobody took advantage of you. Everything we do to your car gets explained in layman's terms, and if you're not fully satisfied, we want to hear about it.
We work on most domestic and foreign vehicles, gas and diesel, cars, trucks, SUVs and minivans. Our neighbors have given us a 4.8 rating across 356 Google reviews.

## Services
- Free air conditioning check: Have your A/C looked at before the hot summer heat sets in.
- Diagnostics: We track down what's wrong using the latest diagnostics equipment.
- Scheduled maintenance and repairs: Factory scheduled maintenance and repairs for cars, SUVs and minivans, along with oil changes, brakes, transmissions, electrical, suspension and wheels and tires.
- Hot rod work: Bring us your hot rod, car or truck and we'll turn it into a mean machine.
- Car and truck lifting and lowering: Lift kits and lowering for cars and trucks.
- Dying battery help: If your battery is dying, give us a call on your way over.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: Most domestic and foreign vehicles, including cars, trucks, SUVs and minivans, gas and diesel.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We're in Gilbert and serve Mesa, Gilbert, Chandler and the surrounding areas.

Q: Is the A/C check really free?
A: Yes. Bring it in and we'll diagnose your A/C before the summer heat hits.
